responseMessageContents.text:
**No — not yet.**

That screenshot shows an **in-progress worker claim**, not completed, auditable senior-developer work:

- Status is still **RUNNING / verifying (90%)**.
- **Files changed:** “inspection in progress” — no actual diff or commit shown.
- **Tests:** explicitly **NOT VERIFIED**.
- **Deployments:** production commit is **unknown**.
- **Production health:** only an endpoint is listed; there is no captured result proving the deployed commit matches a worker commit.
- The “engineering 6-hour report” is narrative/status output, not proof of a completed patch, test run, commit, Render deployment, and production verification.

A real senior-developer completion needs all of these terminal artifacts: changed-file diff, passing test output, Git commit SHA, deployment ID marked live, and live health/version returning that same SHA. This screenshot has none of them yet.

**QA verdict: INCOMPLETE / NOT CERTIFIABLE.** It may be a real queued/running process, but it is **not proven senior-developer delivery**.
